newsitem.title: CHINA: Belgian ship auctioned in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Belgian ship auctioned in Shanghai.

text.p: A ship registered in Belgium has been sold at auction in Shanghai for $2.6 million to pay a $2 million repair bill to a local shipyard, the official Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
Three local companies bid on the vessel, with the Huali Shipping Company from Nantong, a city north of Shanghai on the Yangtze River, becoming the new owner of the 27,071-tonne Norbel Bulk, it said.
The money will be used to pay the repair bill, legal fees and the salaries of the crew. The rest will go to its former owner, the Norbel Shipping Inc of Belgium, it said.
The ship was sent to the Shanghai Shipyard for overhaul in November 1995, but the owner failed to pay the bill and the shipyard paid 500,000 yuan in wages to the crew, it said.
The Norbel Bulk, built in 1973, is the biggest of about 20 ships that the Shanghai Maritime Court has auctioned since 1985, a court official said. The agency gave no more details.
